environment.description: Tomcat 9.0.68 on Amazon Linux 2, fronted by an NLB (Network Load Balancer) with TLS termination. PostgreSQL 14.6 on RDS (db.r5.large) with the application connecting via a db user 'reports_app' that has SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE on the reports schema. No application-layer firewall or request inspection. Security groups allow inbound 443 from 0.0.0.0/0 to NLB, and NLB to Tomcat on 8080.

config.database: PostgreSQL 14.6 RDS, user reports_app with schema-level grants
